name: Low-noise degeneracy and model mismatch for the calibrated waiting rules on B3
reason: Reviewer items R6 and R7: the history estimator degenerates without observation noise, and the rules have only been evaluated with the observation model they assume.

noise_grid.rules: all version-3 rules recalibrated at each level on the calibration samples of the primary split and evaluated on its evaluation samples (likelihood s.d. max(noise, 0.001) as in version 3)
noise_grid.bandwidth_variant: history estimator with likelihood s.d. max(noise, 0.005), calibrated and evaluated the same way
noise_grid.diagnostic: median effective sample size of the history weights at 90 min (evaluation samples, 30-min history) for both bandwidths
noise_grid.sets: reference samples = calibration samples (leave-one-out for calibration plants); evaluation samples never enter references, thresholds or waits

mismatch.rules: frozen version-3 choices (calibrated at white noise 0.005); no re-selection
mismatch.ar1: observation noise e_t = 0.8 e_(t-1) + sqrt(1 - 0.8^2) x 0.005 x eps_t with e_0 = 0.005 x eps_0 (same marginal s.d.); eps from seed 20261009 + 2 x plant + history
mismatch.offset: version-2 observations (white noise 0.005) plus a constant reporter offset of +0.0025
mismatch.evaluation: evaluation samples of the primary split; success and mean failure-penalized completion of the current, smoothed and history rules, the fixed wait and the oracle

reporting: All results reported whatever their direction; simulation of one published model structure.
